purpose: Public image-caption sources for future PRISM connector alignment; not the exact OmniGen2 training mixture.
units: GB and TB are decimal (10^9 and 10^12 bytes); bytes are authoritative.

starter.count_basis: 9647 directly verified unique DOCCI train images plus approximately 60000 publisher-advertised BLIP3o pairs; cross-source deduplication pending.

optional_512px_jpeg_planning_estimate.status: Planning scenario only; not measured or a promise of image quality/retained resolution.

extended.count_basis: Starter plus 116761 directly parsed DenseFusion caption records with unique image IDs, URLs and paths; image-content and cross-source deduplication pending.

optional_512px_jpeg_planning_estimate.status: Planning scenario only; not measured or a promise of image quality/retained resolution.

storage_limitations: Download bytes are verified archive/annotation object sizes, not extracted disk footprints.
The DOCCI archive includes 5200 held-out images; their captions are excluded from the selected training records.
DenseFusion extension uses original JSONL in the future download plan; downloaded converted Parquet is an alternative, not additional required training data.
Do not add DenseFusion 4V and 1M as distinct images: 4V is drawn from the parent pool.
BLIP3o prompt text files do not establish image-to-prompt correspondence; archive validation is deferred until image acquisition.
No author-reviewed semantic or visual quality filtering has been performed on these proposed pools.
